owner_and_capability: Required ownership splits — Backfill Membership and Workforce data from users.staff; School Membership owns users.staff_school_memberships, Workforce owns users.staff_employment_profiles, migrations own platform.storage_backfill_checkpoints
atomic_cutover: No caller switch. Migration 1.15.381 creates the checkpoint table and copies users.staff per school in id-ordered batches of 500 with a persisted high-water mark; each batch is one REPEATABLE READ transaction that upserts memberships and profiles by preserved identity and commits independently. Changed old rows are re-read in further passes until a pass changes nothing and per-tenant counts, checksums and row-wise mismatches agree; the stable checkpoint is the final-delta input for Cutover #2753. No application or database dual write is introduced.
tests: database/migrations: interrupt and resume after every batch boundary, rerun of completed batches, injected 40P01/40001/55P03 with retry accounting and give-up, changed-row re-read plus orphan removal, foreign work-time model rejection, mid-pass rejoin unique-conflict restart, two-tenant RLS reads and checkpoint grant denial, index validity and index-backed batch plan with sequential scans disabled, reset, guarded down/up with the Expand rollback and post-Cutover view guard. cmd: run, status, reset and the unstable non-zero exit against an isolated clone.

runtime_evidence.source: docs/operations/staff-owner-storage-backfill.md (local 2026-09-10 migration and CLI test runs; staging record pending)
runtime_evidence.workload: Local isolated PostgreSQL clones per test with two schools, up to seven staff rows per school covering every copied column, batch sizes 1 to 10, passes until stable. Staging run with the previous image serving staff traffic is pending.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No latency SLO. Acceptance is per tenant: source_count = target_count, equal canonical checksums, mismatch_count 0, rows_rejected explained, stable = true. The command exits non-zero otherwise.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Per batch: one SET LOCAL, one combined CTE statement that reads the batch and upserts both targets, one checkpoint update. Per pass end: one orphan delete transaction, two checksum queries, one mismatch query, one checkpoint update. Per run: one school listing and one sequence alignment.
runtime_evidence.errors: Zero errors in the local suites. Non-transient SQLSTATEs abort the run immediately with the committed checkpoint intact; transient classes retry up to five attempts and then fail with the attempt count.
runtime_evidence.failure: Injected deadlock, serialization failure and lock timeout roll back the batch without double counting rows; the attempt cap surfaces 'gave up after N attempts'. A foreign work-time model reference is rejected, reported as mismatch with oldest_unmigrated_at, and keeps the tenant unstable.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Each interrupted batch rolls back to its previous checkpoint; resume continues exactly one batch further per run in the interrupt test. Reset and the migration down step truncate only target rows and this backfill's checkpoints, keeping other backfills' rows in the shared table; users.staff row JSON is byte-identical before and after. Both refuse when users.staff is a view.
runtime_evidence.smoke: scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development passed for cmd, database/migrations, internal/architecture, seed/api and test; migrate validate passed; architecture check passed with composition 796 -> 796 and 1,647 remaining legacy violations; golangci-lint zero issues; lefthook pre-commit passed. Recorded in docs/operations/staff-owner-storage-backfill.md.
runtime_evidence.affected_rows: Local: rows_copied equals the source count on the first pass, zero on the stabilising pass; rows_removed equals physically deleted source rows. Staging per-tenant totals pending.
runtime_evidence.lock_wait: Batches run under SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; timeouts are counted per tenant as lock_timeouts (zero locally). External blocked-session sampling uses the Expand observer SQL on staging (pending).
runtime_evidence.deadlocks: Counted per tenant from the backfill's own 40P01 retries (zero locally outside the injected case).
runtime_evidence.pool_wait: Pool-wide sql.DBStats wait duration observed while each tenant's batches ran is persisted as pool_wait_ms (zero locally); it is an upper bound that includes concurrent users of the shared process pool.
runtime_evidence.job_duration: batch_p95_ms and batch_max_ms are persisted per tenant; local batches complete in single-digit milliseconds. Staging migration wall time pending.
runtime_evidence.job_retries: batches_retried, deadlocks, serialization_failures and lock_timeouts are persisted per tenant.
runtime_evidence.job_backlog: oldest_unmigrated_at records the oldest differing source row at verification; null once stable.

rollback_and_cleanup: Stop the run and keep the checkpoint. Before Cutover, `backfill staff-owner reset` or migration down truncates only the target rows and checkpoints and restarts from zero; the old authoritative rows are never mutated or deleted. Contract of users.staff happens after the Cutover rollback window, not here.
exit_criterion: Every school reports stable = true with equal counts and checksums, zero mismatches and orphans, and a complete checkpoint while users.staff remains authoritative. scripts/backend-architecture.sh check introduces no key and leaves policy ownership unchanged; the new checkpoint table is owned by migrations.
